verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֹּ֖א אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֞י הִכְבַּ֤דְתִּי אֶת־ לִבּוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ לֵ֣ב עֲבָדָ֔יו לְמַ֗עַן שִׁתִ֛י אֹתֹתַ֥י אֵ֖לֶּה בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh bō ’el- par·‘ōh kî- ’ă·nî hiḵ·baḏ·tî ’eṯ- lib·bōw wə·’eṯ- lêḇ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw lə·ma·‘an ši·ṯî ’ō·ṯō·ṯay ’êl·leh bə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Go to Pharaoh for I have hardened his heart and the hearts of his officials that I may perform these miraculous signs of Mine among them
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Entra a Faraó. Eu endureci o seu coração e o coração dos seus servos, para que eu manifeste estes meus prodígios no meio deles

verses.original: וּלְמַ֡עַן תְּסַפֵּר֩ בְּאָזְנֵ֨י בִנְךָ֜ וּבֶן־ בִּנְךָ֗ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִתְעַלַּ֙לְתִּי֙ בְּמִצְרַ֔יִם וְאֶת־ אֹתֹתַ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֣מְתִּי בָ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ma·‘an tə·sap·pêr bə·’ā·zə·nê ḇin·ḵā ū·ḇen- bin·ḵā ’êṯ ’ă·šer hiṯ·‘al·lal·tî bə·miṣ·ra·yim wə·’eṯ- ’ō·ṯō·ṯay ’ă·šer- śam·tî ḇām wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: and that you may tell . . . your children and grandchildren . . . how severely I dealt with the Egyptians when I performed miraculous signs among them so that all of you may know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: e para que contes aos ouvidos de teus filhos e dos filhos de teus filhos que coisas tenho obrado no Egito e os meus prodígios que tenho feito no meio deles; a fim de que saibais que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְאַהֲרֹן֮ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹה֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽעִבְרִ֔ים עַד־ מָתַ֣י מֵאַ֔נְתָּ לֵעָנֹ֖ת מִפָּנָ֑י שַׁלַּ֥ח עַמִּ֖י וְיַֽעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō mō·šeh wə·’a·hă·rōn ’el- par·‘ōh way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘iḇ·rîm ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay mê·’an·tā lê·‘ā·nōṯ mip·pā·nāy šal·laḥ ‘am·mî wə·ya·‘aḇ·ḏu·nî
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and told him This is what the LORD the God of the Hebrews says How long . . . will you refuse to humble yourself before Me Let My people go so that they may worship Me
verses.literalPt: Entraram, pois, Moisés e Arão a Faraó e lhe disseram: Assim diz Jeová, o Deus dos hebreus: Até quando recusarás humilhar-te diante de mim? Deixa ir o meu povo para que me sirva.

verses.original: כִּ֛י אִם־ מָאֵ֥ן אַתָּ֖ה לְשַׁלֵּ֣חַ אֶת־ עַמִּ֑י הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִ֥יא מָחָ֛ר אַרְבֶּ֖ה בִּגְבֻלֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- mā·’ên ’at·tāh lə·šal·lê·aḥ ’eṯ- ‘am·mî hin·nî mê·ḇî mā·ḥār ’ar·beh biḡ·ḇu·le·ḵā
verses.literal: But if you refuse to let My people . . . go I will bring locusts into your territory tomorrow
verses.literalPt: De outra forma, se tu recusares deixar ir o meu povo, eis que amanhã trarei gafanhotos aos teus termos;

verses.original: וְכִסָּה֙ אֶת־ עֵ֣ין הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א יוּכַ֖ל לִרְאֹ֣ת אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְאָכַ֣ל׀ אֶת־ יֶ֣תֶר הַפְּלֵטָ֗ה הַנִּשְׁאֶ֤רֶת לָכֶם֙ מִן־ הַבָּרָ֔ד וְאָכַל֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעֵ֔ץ הַצֹּמֵ֥חַ לָכֶ֖ם מִן־ הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵis·sāh ’eṯ- ‘ên hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō yū·ḵal lir·’ōṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’ā·ḵal ’eṯ- ye·ṯer hap·pə·lê·ṭāh han·niš·’e·reṯ lā·ḵem min- hab·bā·rāḏ wə·’ā·ḵal ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘êṣ haṣ·ṣō·mê·aḥ lā·ḵem min- haś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: They will cover the face of the land so that no one can see it They will devour whatever is left after the hail and eat every tree that grows in your . . . fields
verses.literalPt: eles cobrirão a face da terra, de sorte que a terra não se poderá ver; comerão o restante do que escapou e que vos resta da chuva de pedras e comerão toda árvore que vos cresce no campo.

verses.original: וּמָלְא֨וּ בָתֶּ֜יךָ וּבָתֵּ֣י כָל־ עֲבָדֶיךָ֮ וּבָתֵּ֣י כָל־ מִצְרַיִם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־ רָא֤וּ אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ וַאֲב֣וֹת אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ מִיּ֗וֹם הֱיוֹתָם֙ עַל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וַיִּ֥פֶן וַיֵּצֵ֖א מֵעִ֥ם פַּרְעֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mā·lə·’ū ḇāt·te·ḵā ū·ḇāt·tê ḵāl ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ū·ḇāt·tê ḵāl miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer lō- rā·’ū ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā wa·’ă·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā mî·yō·wm hĕ·yō·w·ṯām ‘al- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh way·yi·p̄en way·yê·ṣê mê·‘im par·‘ōh
verses.literal: They will fill your houses and the houses of all your officials and every Egyptian something neither your fathers nor your grandfathers . . . have seen since the day they came into . . . this land . . . . . . . . . Then Moses turned and left . . . Pharaoh’s presence
verses.literalPt: Encher-se-ão as tuas casas, e as casas de todos os teus servos, e as casas de todos os egípcios, como nunca viram teus pais nem os pais de teus pais, desde o dia em que nasceram na terra até o dia de hoje. Virou-se e saiu da presença de Faraó.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ עַבְדֵ֨י פַרְעֹ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו עַד־ מָתַי֙ יִהְיֶ֨ה זֶ֥ה לָ֙נוּ֙ לְמוֹקֵ֔שׁ שַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְיַֽעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם הֲטֶ֣רֶם תֵּדַ֔ע כִּ֥י אָבְדָ֖ה מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ‘aḇ·ḏê p̄ar·‘ōh ’ê·lāw ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay yih·yeh zeh lā·nū lə·mō·w·qêš šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·’ă·nā·šîm wə·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem hă·ṭe·rem tê·ḏa‘ kî ’ā·ḇə·ḏāh miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Pharaoh’s . . . officials asked him How long . . . will this man be a snare to us Let the people go so that they may worship the LORD their God Do you not yet realize . . . that Egypt lies in ruins
verses.literalPt: Então, os servos de Faraó lhe disseram: Até quando nos servirá de laço este homem? Deixa ir os homens, para que sirvam a Jeová seu Deus. Porventura, não sabes ainda que o Egito está desolado?

verses.original: וַיּוּשַׁ֞ב אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם לְכ֥וּ עִבְד֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם מִ֥י וָמִ֖י הַהֹלְכִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yū·šaḇ ’eṯ- mō·šeh wə·’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn ’el- par·‘ōh way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem lə·ḵū ‘iḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem mî wā·mî ha·hō·lə·ḵîm
verses.literal: So Moses and Aaron were brought back to Pharaoh Go worship the LORD your God he said . . . But who exactly . . . will be going
verses.literalPt: Moisés e Arão foram levados outra vez a Faraó; e ele lhes disse: Ide, servi a Jeová, vosso Deus; mas quem são os que hão de ir?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה בִּנְעָרֵ֥ינוּ וּבִזְקֵנֵ֖ינוּ נֵלֵ֑ךְ בְּבָנֵ֨ינוּ וּבִבְנוֹתֵ֜נוּ בְּצֹאנֵ֤נוּ וּבִבְקָרֵ֙נוּ֙ נֵלֵ֔ךְ כִּ֥י חַג־ יְהוָ֖ה לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh bin·‘ā·rê·nū ū·ḇiz·qê·nê·nū nê·lêḵ bə·ḇā·nê·nū ū·ḇiḇ·nō·w·ṯê·nū bə·ṣō·nê·nū ū·ḇiḇ·qā·rê·nū nê·lêḵ kî ḥaḡ- Yah·weh lā·nū
verses.literal: We will go with our young and old Moses replied We will go with our sons and daughters and with our flocks and herds for we must hold a feast to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Moisés: Havemos de ir com os nossos jovens, e com os nossos velhos, com nossos filhos e com nossas filhas, com os nossos rebanhos, e com os nossos gados havemos de ir, porque temos de celebrar uma festa a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם יְהִ֨י כֵ֤ן יְהוָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר אֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶתְכֶ֖ם וְאֶֽת־ טַפְּכֶ֑ם רְא֕וּ כִּ֥י רָעָ֖ה נֶ֥גֶד פְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yə·hî ḵên Yah·weh ‘im·mā·ḵem ka·’ă·šer ’ă·šal·laḥ ’eṯ·ḵem wə·’eṯ- ṭap·pə·ḵem rə·’ū kî rā·‘āh ne·ḡeḏ pə·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh told them May the LORD . . . be with you if I ever let you go - with your little ones Clearly . . . you are bent . . . on evil
verses.literalPt: Replicou-lhes Faraó: Assim seja Jeová convosco, como eu vos deixarei ir a vós e a vossos pequeninos; olhai, porque o mal está diante de vós.

verses.original: לֹ֣א כֵ֗ן לְכֽוּ־ נָ֤א הַגְּבָרִים֙ וְעִבְד֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אֹתָ֖הּ אַתֶּ֣ם מְבַקְשִׁ֑ים וַיְגָ֣רֶשׁ אֹתָ֔ם מֵאֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֥י פַרְעֹֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō ḵên lə·ḵū- nā hag·gə·ḇā·rîm wə·‘iḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh kî ’ō·ṯāh ’at·tem mə·ḇaq·šîm way·ḡā·reš ’ō·ṯām mê·’êṯ pə·nê p̄ar·‘ōh
verses.literal: No . . . only the men may go . . . and worship the LORD since that is what you have been requesting And Moses and Aaron were driven from Pharaoh’s presence
verses.literalPt: Não há de ser assim; ide agora vós que sois homens e servi a Jeová; pois é isso o que vós desejais. E foram expulsos da presença de Faraó.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה נְטֵ֨ה יָדְךָ֜ עַל־ אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בָּֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה וְיַ֖עַל עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְיֹאכַל֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ עֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִשְׁאִ֖יר הַבָּרָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh nə·ṭêh yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim bā·’ar·beh wə·ya·‘al ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·yō·ḵal ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ê·śeḇ hā·’ā·reṣ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer hiš·’îr hab·bā·rāḏ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Stretch out your hand over the land of Egypt so that the locusts may swarm over it . . . and devour every plant in the land everything that the hail has left behind
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Estende a mão sobre a terra do Egito, para que subam os gafanhotos sobre a terra do Egito e comam toda a erva, tudo o que deixou a chuva de pedras.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨ט מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶת־ מַטֵּהוּ֮ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַֽיהוָ֗ה נִהַ֤ג ר֥וּחַ קָדִים֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ כָּל־ הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא וְכָל־ הַלָּ֑יְלָה הַבֹּ֣קֶר הָיָ֔ה וְר֙וּחַ֙ הַקָּדִ֔ים נָשָׂ֖א אֶת־ הָאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ mō·šeh ’eṯ- maṭ·ṭê·hū ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim Yah·weh ni·haḡ rū·aḥ qā·ḏîm bā·’ā·reṣ kāl- hay·yō·wm ha·hū wə·ḵāl hal·lā·yə·lāh hab·bō·qer hā·yāh wə·rū·aḥ haq·qā·ḏîm nā·śā ’eṯ- hā·’ar·beh
verses.literal: So Moses stretched out his staff over the land of Egypt and throughout that . . . day and night the LORD sent an east wind across the land By morning . . . the east wind had brought the locusts
verses.literalPt: Estendeu Moisés a sua vara sobre a terra do Egito, e trouxe Jeová sobre a terra um vento oriental todo aquele dia e toda a noite; quando amanheceu, o vento oriental trouxe os gafanhotos.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַל הָֽאַרְבֶּ֗ה עַ֚ל כָּל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַיָּ֕נַח בְּכֹ֖ל גְּב֣וּל מִצְרָ֑יִם כָּבֵ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד לְ֠פָנָיו לֹא־ הָ֨יָה כֵ֤ן אַרְבֶּה֙ כָּמֹ֔הוּ וְאַחֲרָ֖יו לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־ כֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al hā·’ar·beh ‘al kāl- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·yā·naḥ bə·ḵōl gə·ḇūl miṣ·rā·yim kā·ḇêḏ mə·’ōḏ lə·p̄ā·nāw lō- hā·yāh ḵên ’ar·beh kā·mō·hū wə·’a·ḥă·rāw lō yih·yeh- kên
verses.literal: The locusts swarmed across . . . the land and settled over the entire territory of Egypt Never before had there been so many . . . locusts . . . . . . and never again will there be . . .
verses.literalPt: Os gafanhotos subiram sobre a terra do Egito e sentaram-se em todos os termos do Egito. Mui malignos foram; antes desses, nunca houve tais gafanhotos como eles, nem virão depois desses outros tais.

verses.original: וַיְכַ֞ס אֶת־ עֵ֣ין כָּל־ הָאָרֶץ֮ וַתֶּחְשַׁ֣ךְ הָאָרֶץ֒ וַיֹּ֜אכַל אֶת־ כָּל־ עֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָ֗רֶץ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ פְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹתִ֖יר הַבָּרָ֑ד וְלֹא־ נוֹתַ֨ר כָּל־ יֶ֧רֶק בָּעֵ֛ץ וּבְעֵ֥שֶׂב הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḵas ’eṯ- ‘ên kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ wat·teḥ·šaḵ hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·ḵal ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ê·śeḇ hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’êṯ kāl- pə·rî hā·‘êṣ ’ă·šer hō·w·ṯîr hab·bā·rāḏ wə·lō- nō·w·ṯar kāl- ye·req bā·‘êṣ ū·ḇə·‘ê·śeḇ haś·śā·ḏeh bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: They covered the face of all the land until it was black and they consumed all the plants on the ground and all the fruit on the trees that the hail had left behind Nothing . . . green was left on any tree or plant . . . in all the land of Egypt
verses.literalPt: Pois cobriram a face de toda a terra, de modo que a terra se escureceu; comeram toda a erva da terra e todo fruto das árvores, que deixara a chuva de pedras; nada verde ficou nas árvores nem nas ervas do campo por toda a terra do Egito.

verses.original: וַיְמַהֵ֣ר פַּרְעֹ֔ה לִקְרֹ֖א לְמֹשֶׁ֣ה וּֽלְאַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר חָטָ֛אתִי לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֖ם וְלָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hêr par·‘ōh liq·rō lə·mō·šeh ū·lə·’a·hă·rōn way·yō·mer ḥā·ṭā·ṯî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·lā·ḵem
verses.literal: Pharaoh quickly summoned Moses and Aaron and said I have sinned against the LORD your God and against you
verses.literalPt: Então, a toda pressa, mandou Faraó chamar a Moisés e a Arão e lhes disse: Pequei contra Jeová, vosso Deus, e contra vós.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה שָׂ֣א נָ֤א חַטָּאתִי֙ אַ֣ךְ הַפַּ֔עַם וְהַעְתִּ֖ירוּ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְיָסֵר֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י רַ֖ק אֶת־ הַמָּ֥וֶת הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh śā nā ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯî ’aḵ hap·pa·‘am wə·ha‘·tî·rū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·yā·sêr mê·‘ā·lay raq ’eṯ- ham·mā·weṯ haz·zeh
verses.literal: Now please forgive my sin once more . . . and appeal to the LORD your God that He may remove this death from me . . .
verses.literalPt: Agora, perdoai-me somente esta vez o meu pecado e rogai a Jeová, vosso Deus, que tire de mim esta morte somente.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֖א מֵעִ֣ם פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַיֶּעְתַּ֖ר אֶל־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê mê·‘im par·‘ōh way·ye‘·tar ’el- Yah·weh
verses.literal: So Moses left . . . Pharaoh’s presence and appealed to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Tendo Moisés saído da presença de Faraó, rogou a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּהֲפֹ֨ךְ יְהוָ֤ה רֽוּחַ־ יָם֙ חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֔ד וַיִּשָּׂא֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אַרְבֶּ֔ה וַיִּתְקָעֵ֖הוּ יָ֣מָּה סּ֑וּף לֹ֤א נִשְׁאַר֙ אַרְבֶּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד בְּכֹ֖ל גְּב֥וּל מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·hă·p̄ōḵ Yah·weh rū·aḥ- yām ḥā·zāq mə·’ōḏ way·yiś·śā ’eṯ- hā·’ar·beh way·yiṯ·qā·‘ê·hū yām·māh sūp̄ lō niš·’ar ’ar·beh ’e·ḥāḏ bə·ḵōl gə·ḇūl miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: And the LORD changed the wind to a very strong . . . west wind that carried off the locusts and blew them into the Red Sea Not a single locust remained anywhere in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Jeová fez soprar um forte vento ocidental, que levantou os gafanhotos e os lançou no mar Vermelho; não ficou um só gafanhoto em todos os termos do Egito.

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְלֹ֥א שִׁלַּ֖ח אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ḥaz·zêq Yah·weh ’eṯ- lêḇ par·‘ōh wə·lō šil·laḥ ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart and he would not let the Israelites . . . go
verses.literalPt: Mas Jeová endureceu o coração de Faraó, e este não deixou ir os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה נְטֵ֤ה יָֽדְךָ֙ עַל־ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וִ֥יהִי חֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְיָמֵ֖שׁ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh nə·ṭêh yā·ḏə·ḵā ‘al- haš·šā·ma·yim wî·hî ḥō·šeḵ ‘al- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·yā·mêš ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Stretch out your hand toward heaven so that darkness may spread over the land of Egypt a palpable darkness
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés: Estende a mão para o céu, para que haja trevas sobre a terra do Egito, trevas que se possam apalpar.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥ט מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ יָד֖וֹ עַל־ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיְהִ֧י חֹֽשֶׁךְ־ אֲפֵלָ֛ה בְּכָל־ אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yêṭ mō·šeh ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al- haš·šā·mā·yim way·hî ḥō·šeḵ- ’ă·p̄ê·lāh bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: So Moses stretched out his hand toward heaven and total darkness covered all the land of Egypt for three days
verses.literalPt: Estendeu, pois, Moisés a mão para o céu; e houve trevas espessas em toda a terra do Egito por três dias;

verses.original: לֹֽא־ רָא֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ אָחִ֗יו וְלֹא־ קָ֛מוּ אִ֥ישׁ מִתַּחְתָּ֖יו שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וּֽלְכָל־ בְּנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָ֥יָה א֖וֹר בְּמוֹשְׁבֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lō- rā·’ū ’îš ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥîw wə·lō- qā·mū ’îš mit·taḥ·tāw šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm ū·lə·ḵāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·yāh ’ō·wr bə·mō·wō·šə·ḇō·ṯām
verses.literal: No one could see anyone else and for three days no one left . . . his place Yet all the Israelites . . . had light in their dwellings
verses.literalPt: não viram uns aos outros, e ninguém se levantou do seu lugar por três dias; porém todos os filhos de Israel tinham luz nas suas habitações.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א פַרְעֹ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לְכוּ֙ עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה רַ֛ק צֹאנְכֶ֥ם וּבְקַרְכֶ֖ם יֻצָּ֑ג גַּֽם־ טַפְּכֶ֖ם יֵלֵ֥ךְ עִמָּכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā p̄ar·‘ōh ’el- mō·šeh way·yō·mer lə·ḵū ‘iḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh raq ṣō·nə·ḵem ū·ḇə·qar·ḵem yuṣ·ṣāḡ gam- ṭap·pə·ḵem yê·lêḵ ‘im·mā·ḵem
verses.literal: Then Pharaoh . . . summoned Moses and said Go worship the LORD Even your little ones may go with you only your flocks and herds must stay behind
verses.literalPt: Mandou Faraó chamar a Moisés e disse: Ide, servi a Jeová. Fiquem somente os vossos rebanhos e os vossos gados; e vão convosco os vossos pequeninos.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה גַּם־ אַתָּ֛ה תִּתֵּ֥ן בְּיָדֵ֖נוּ זְבָחִ֣ים וְעֹל֑וֹת וְעָשִׂ֖ינוּ לַיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh gam- ’at·tāh tit·tên bə·yā·ḏê·nū zə·ḇā·ḥîm wə·‘ō·lō·wṯ wə·‘ā·śî·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: But Moses replied You must also provide us with sacrifices and burnt offerings to present to the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Moisés: Também tu nos tens de dar nas mãos sacrifícios e holocaustos, para que ofereçamos sacrifícios a Jeová, nosso Deus.

verses.original: וְגַם־ מִקְנֵ֜נוּ יֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֗נוּ לֹ֤א תִשָּׁאֵר֙ פַּרְסָ֔ה כִּ֚י מִמֶּ֣נּוּ נִקַּ֔ח לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ לֹֽא־ נֵדַ֗ע מַֽה־ נַּעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה עַד־ בֹּאֵ֖נוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- miq·nê·nū yê·lêḵ ‘im·mā·nū lō ṯiš·šā·’êr par·sāh kî mim·men·nū niq·qaḥ la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wa·’ă·naḥ·nū lō- nê·ḏa‘ mah- na·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ‘aḏ- bō·’ê·nū šām·māh
verses.literal: Even our livestock must go with us not a hoof will be left behind for we will need some of them to worship the LORD our God and we will not know how we are to worship the LORD until we arrive . . .
verses.literalPt: Também o nosso gado irá conosco; nem uma unha ficará, porque deles havemos de tomar para servir a Jeová, nosso Deus, e nós não sabemos com que havemos de servir a Jeová, até que cheguemos lá.

verses.original: וַיְחַזֵּ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ לֵ֣ב פַּרְעֹ֑ה וְלֹ֥א אָבָ֖ה לְשַׁלְּחָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḥaz·zêq Yah·weh ’eṯ- lêḇ par·‘ōh wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh lə·šal·lə·ḥām
verses.literal: But the LORD hardened Pharaoh’s heart and he was unwilling . . . to let them go
verses.literalPt: Mas Jeová endureceu o coração de Faraó, e este não os quis deixar ir.

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמֶר־ ל֥וֹ פַרְעֹ֖ה לֵ֣ךְ מֵעָלָ֑י הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֗ אֶל־ תֹּ֙סֶף֙ רְא֣וֹת פָּנַ֔י כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם רְאֹתְךָ֥ פָנַ֖י תָּמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer- lōw p̄ar·‘ōh lêḵ mê·‘ā·lāy hiš·šā·mer lə·ḵā ’el- tō·sep̄ rə·’ō·wṯ pā·nay kî bə·yō·wm rə·’ō·ṯə·ḵā p̄ā·nay tā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Depart from me Pharaoh said to Moses Make sure you never see my face again for on the day you see my face you will die
verses.literalPt: Disse, pois, Faraó a Moisés: Retira-te de mim, guarda-te não vejas mais o meu rosto, porque, no dia em que vires o meu rosto, morrerás.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֣ן דִּבַּ֑רְתָּ לֹא־ אֹסִ֥ף ע֖וֹד רְא֥וֹת פָּנֶֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer mō·šeh kên dib·bar·tā lō- ’ō·sip̄ ‘ō·wḏ rə·’ō·wṯ pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: As you say Moses replied I will never see your face again . . .
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhe Moisés: Falaste bem; eu nunca mais hei de ver o teu rosto.
